_comment: EAS Build configuration for PadelAppRetas. Refer to https://docs.expo.dev/eas/json/ for full schema.

build._comment_development: Development client + dev server. Use when you need hot-reload on a physical device with native modules (push, deep links).
build._comment_preview: Internal QA testing — TestFlight (iOS) + Firebase App Distribution / APK (Android). Ideal para validar Universal Links + Push antes de submit a stores.
build._comment_production: Production builds. iOS → App Store, Android → Play Store (AAB).

ios._comment: Reemplazar con tu Apple ID y App Store Connect API key path tras inscripción en Apple Developer

android._comment: serviceAccountKeyPath debe apuntar a la Service Account JSON descargada de Google Play Console
